title: Ramayana crosses ₹1,500 crore worldwide, 5th-highest-grossing Indian film (Sacnilk, Koimoi)
headline: Ramayana Crosses ₹1,500 Crore, India's 5th-Highest Grosser Ever
caption:
Ramayana has crossed ₹1,500 crore at the worldwide box office, trackers Sacnilk and Koimoi estimate, making it the fifth-highest-grossing Indian film ever.

Sacnilk counts ₹1,519 crore after 14 days in cinemas, to Wednesday 18 November: ₹1,009 crore gross in India and ₹510 crore overseas. Koimoi's count is also past ₹1,500 crore. The makers have not confirmed a figure.

Only four Indian films have grossed more worldwide: Dangal (₹2,070 crore), Dhurandhar 2 (over ₹1,800 crore), Baahubali 2 (₹1,788 crore) and Pushpa 2 (over ₹1,700 crore). Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana, with Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana, is about ₹200 crore short of Pushpa 2.

Both trackers also say Ramayana had Hindi cinema's biggest second week in India, ahead of Dhurandhar 2.

Sources: Sacnilk, Koimoi, Business Today
